desc:
Build your dream hideout and sword fight with other players! Rack up your points and KOs to climb the leaderboard and purchase exclusive swords and gear. This game is far different from the other versions on Roblox, featuring way more gear and items to build your base with!

This game is based on the classic Roblox build and fight games. It's also apart of my ultimate game building series, featuring the same building system. That means features like team building, save slots, tons of models/parts, and the configure/wiring tools are here! With so many new items to build with and customizations, the possibilities are endless!

Each kill earns you 10 points. Leaderstats and your base also save across servers!

Checkout Welcome to Roblox Building Ultimate here for only the sandbox aspect of the game with no weapons! https://www.roblox.com/games/2785023050/WTRBU

Please give a like and favorite if you enjoy the game, it really helps! 👍
This game works on mobile but is best played on PC.
